questions.question:
Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

35 + 7 × 12 − 6 ÷ 2 = 6

Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(8, 4, 1)

(12, 4, 5)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**(1st number - 2nd number) - 3 = 3rd number**.

Here, for (8, 4, 1)

(8 - 4) - 3

⇒ 4 - 3 = 1.

(12, 4, 5)

(12 - 4) - 3

⇒ 8 - 3 = 5.

Similarly, for **(17, 8, 6)**

**(17 - 8) - 3**

**⇒ 9 - 3 = 6.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

questions.question:
By interchanging the given two signs ÷ and –, which of the following equations will be correct?

I. 143 + 6 × 18 ÷ 45 – 3 = 236

II. 133 – 7 + 16 × 11 ÷ 37 = 158
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation I: 143 + 6 × 18 ÷ 45 – 3 = 236

Now, if '÷ and –' are interchanged, then:

⇒ 143 + 6 × 18 - __**45 ÷ 3**__ = 236

⇒ 143 + __**6 × 18**__ - 15 = 236

⇒ __**143 + 108**__ - 15 = 236

⇒ __251 - 15__ = 236

= **236 = 236.**

**LHS = RHS.**

Given equation II: 133 – 7 + 16 × 11 ÷ 37 = 158

Now, if '÷ and –' are interchanged, then:

⇒ __**133 ÷ 7**__ + 16 × 11 - 37 = 158

⇒ 19 + __**16 × 11**__ - 37 = 158

⇒ __**19 + 176**__ – 37 = 158

⇒ __**195 – 37**__ = 158

= **158 = 158**

LHS = RHS.

Here, Both I and II are correct equation after interchanging the given symbol.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some festivals are fireworks.

No cracker is a firework.

No bomb is a festival.

**Conclusions:**

I. No bomb is a cracker.

II. Some bombs are crackers.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Either conclusion I or II follows

questions.solution:
Statement:

Some festivals are fireworks.

No cracker is a firework.

No bomb is a festival.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83016bc8e108f61a21be7c2c82b10f31e1c5f04d7966598932f6bd31b1bbca3e.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) No bomb is a cracker - False (Because No direct relation given between Bomb and Cracker, so it can be possible not definite).

(ii) Some bombs are crackers - False (Because No direct relation given between Bomb and Cracker, so it can be possible not definite).

Here, Both the conclusions are wrong, but it forms the complementary pair for Either-or.

Here, Either conclusion I or II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Complementary pairs for Either or case are:-

1) Some + No

2) All + Some not

Rules for Either or Case:-

1. Subject and Predicate of the element should be same.

2. Two of the conclusions should be can’t be determined.

3. Both should form a complementary pair.

Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

For, 125 : 25

5³ → 125.

5² → 25.

For, 64 : 16

43 → 64.

42 → 16.

Similarly, for 216 : ?

**63 → 216.**

**62 → 36.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"36"**.

questions.question: Among five friends P, Q, R, S and T, T is taller than only three other friends. R is the tallest among all friends. Q is taller than only one person. Only two persons are taller than P. Who is the shortest among all the friends?
questions.solution:
Given: Five friends P, Q, R, S and T. 

1) R is the tallest among all friends.

R > __ > __ > __ > __

2) Q is taller than only one person.

R > __ > __ > Q > __

3) Only two persons are taller than P.

R > __ > P > Q > __

4) T is taller than only three other friends.

R > T > P > Q > __

So, S will be the remaining person, and he will be the shortest one.

R > T > P > Q > S

So, 'S' is the shortest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"S"**.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'ELITE' is coded as '3', and 'BLUE' is coded as '2'. How will 'ABSENCE' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Number of Vowels in the word is the code for that word.**

For, 'ELITE' is coded as '3'

Number of Vowels in word 'ELITE' = 3 (EIE)

For, 'BLUE' is coded as '2'

Number of Vowels in word 'BLUE' = 2 (UE)

Similarly, for ABSENCE:

**Number of Vowels in word 'ABSENCE' = 3 (AEE)**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
